language.basis: rtl/design.v:42-58 生效分支（未定义 IS_CYCLONEV 走 `else）仅用 reg 数组、always @(posedge)、$readmemh、integer for 循环，均为 Verilog-2005 语法；无 SystemVerilog 构造，也未把 do 等保留字用作标识符。generate/genvar 仅出现在未激活的 `ifdef IS_CYCLONEV 分支（rtl/design.v:18-39）。

ports.name: clk
ports.basis: rtl/design.v:9 声明；rtl/design.v:48 作为 always @(posedge clk) 的时钟

ports.name: en
ports.basis: rtl/design.v:10 声明；rtl/design.v:49 在时钟沿作为使能条件采样

ports.name: we
ports.basis: rtl/design.v:11 声明 [DATA_W/8-1:0]，默认 DATA_W=32（rtl/design.v:6）故宽 4；rtl/design.v:51 逐位字节写使能

ports.name: addr
ports.basis: rtl/design.v:12 声明 [ADDR_W-1:0]，默认 ADDR_W=10（rtl/design.v:5）；rtl/design.v:52,55 作地址

ports.name: din
ports.basis: rtl/design.v:13 声明 [DATA_W-1:0]，默认 DATA_W=32；rtl/design.v:52 写入数据

ports.name: dout
ports.basis: rtl/design.v:14 声明 [DATA_W-1:0]；rtl/design.v:55,58 由寄存器 dout_int 驱动

clocks.name: clk
clocks.basis: rtl/design.v:9 顶层输入端口；rtl/design.v:48 always @(posedge clk) 上升沿触发，无内部分频/倍频或门控结构

io_clock_associations.basis: rtl/design.v:48-49 在 always @(posedge clk) 内采样
rtl/design.v:48,51 在 always @(posedge clk) 内采样
rtl/design.v:48,52,55 在 always @(posedge clk) 内采样
rtl/design.v:48,52 在 always @(posedge clk) 内采样
rtl/design.v:48,55,58 由 clk 域寄存器 dout_int 输出

memories_or_initialization.description: rtl/design.v:42 声明 reg [DATA_W-1:0] ram_block[(2**ADDR_W)-1:0] 推断存储阵列；rtl/design.v:43-45 initial 块在 mem_init_file_int != "none.hex" 时条件执行 $readmemh。默认 HEXFILE="none"（rtl/design.v:4），初始化实际不加载任何文件。
